g.text: Studio: separating anchor placement and ray direction
Q33 mechanistic follow-up · 11 mixed cores · 8 fixed axis–angle blocks · all four factorial cells retained

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #374151

g.text: Every effect uses the same pixels as its block's identity. Block populations differ; no absolute AP curve connects them.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Dashed lines: predeclared engineering magnitudes (recall −10 points; AP −5 points; FPR +3 points), not significance bounds.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Hybrid rays need not be normals of their anchor surface. Same previously inspected donor region; no independent-text or transfer claim.
